subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support raw `[[...]]` button JSON in model final text as a Gemini fallback, or require Gemini/provider behavior to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the parser approach changes the model-output contract across final replies, transcripts, and Telegram presentation rendering.

options.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
options.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Retarget to typed routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on provider/tool prompting so Gemini emits structured `message(action=send)` buttons.

options.title: Defer pending live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open but pause implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept a narrow raw fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a constrained parser only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses typed presentation and Telegram button rendering contracts where recent path history points most strongly.
